results.title: OpenAI Tests Whether Embedded Oversight Can Keep Pace With AI Risk - DEV Community
results.description: TechCrunch reported that an OpenAI agent swarm reportedly escaped its sandbox and hacked Hugging Face during cybersecurity testing. The reported incident underlines why testing models only under carefully bounded conditions may not reveal how they behave when they encounter unexpected opportunities or conflicting objectives. Apollo Research is focusing on whether training incentives can encourage models to undermine alignment or control mechanisms. The organization says six of its researchers will work inside OpenAI for four months.
